problem: A coating line must run faster, but longer continuous exposure causes uneven curing and scrap.
initial_state: One continuous curing path handles every product the same way.
desired_improvement: Increase throughput without increasing curing defects.
worsening_consequence: A single uninterrupted run produces defects that require rework.
displayed_solution: Divide the line into independently monitored curing zones, each with its own timing and adjustment range.
resulting_state: Products move through separately managed curing zones with stable quality.

problem: A deployment process fails when a database migration is performed after application traffic has already switched to the new release.
initial_state: Traffic is switched before the new database fields are available.
desired_improvement: Reduce downtime during a schema-changing deployment.
worsening_consequence: The new application expects fields that the live database does not yet provide.
displayed_solution: Run the compatibility migration before switching traffic, then reverse the order during rollback so traffic returns before the old schema cleanup is removed.
resulting_state: Forward and rollback sequences use opposite safe orderings.

problem: A portable monitor must be small enough to wear, but its single sensor placement misses changes caused by movement.
initial_state: One fixed sensor is responsible for every reading.
desired_improvement: Maintain reliable readings while the wearer moves.
worsening_consequence: A fixed sensor loses contact or produces delayed readings.
displayed_solution: Use two independently positioned sensing patches and reverse the sensing priority when motion causes one patch to lose contact.
resulting_state: Separate sensing patches provide readings under changing motion conditions.

problem: A greenhouse crop receives too much water during cool periods and too little during sudden heat.
desired_improvement: Keep soil moisture within a useful range as conditions change.
worsening_consequence: A fixed schedule either wastes water or stresses the plants.
displayed_solution: Continuously change the irrigation rate from current temperature and soil readings rather than using a fixed schedule.
resulting_state: Irrigation adapts continuously to measured growing conditions.

problem: A fragile instrument shifts inside a reusable case during transport.
initial_state: The instrument rests in one open cavity with no defined contact arrangement.
desired_improvement: Prevent damage without permanently filling the case with packing material.
worsening_consequence: The instrument may contact the case wall during an unmeasured vibration pattern.
displayed_solution: Add a suitable internal support arrangement.
resulting_state: The instrument is held by a support arrangement whose geometry is not specified.

problem: A battery module becomes difficult to service when all cells are permanently enclosed, but exposed cells are vulnerable to local heating.
initial_state: All cells share one enclosed module volume.
desired_improvement: Allow safe replacement of a faulty cell without exposing the whole module.
worsening_consequence: One hot cell can force removal of the entire module.
displayed_solution: Separate the module into replaceable thermal sections, each isolated from its neighbors and removable independently.
resulting_state: Thermally isolated sections can be removed independently within the same footprint.
